title: gliricidia cubensis
intro: Gliricidia cubensis, commonly known as Cuban tree or Cuban mahogany, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gliricidia cubensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Gliricidia cubensis have been found to exhibit significant antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
